title: Former MAGA Influencer Admits: It’s All for Money

content:

**Justin Baragona** here, bringing you the latest media dispatches from the

For one brief moment this week, it seemed that **Donald Trump 's** deranged
behavior had finally reached a point where even his most diehard loyalists in
the MAGA media ecosystem couldn't stand behind him.

That blowback, of course, was short-lived and quickly replaced by praise for
the president. And with the conservative attention economy showing the need
for pro-Trump grifters to stay in their MAGA lane to keep the dollars flowing,
we have someone who was deep inside that bubble spilling the tea on how this
exactly works.
